name: mid_session_charger_fault
description: A charger faults while a session is active
seed_discipline: run under a fixed seed; cite the run ID
mechanism: three live forms: cert-arm fault_chargers=N (STRESS_OUTAGE_CERT), twin.ottoq_report_charger_fault(charger_id), otto-twin-control POST inject_fault {kind: charger_offline, target_id}
expected_kernel_behavior: session ends faulted; vehicle re-enters stall-assignment same tick (P0 reopened-need rule); certify_run B3 (charge-on-faulted) stays zero
